THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTE: The source of corruption, I have come to correct you.
I am correctness, I am justice. All of you are unreasonable wretches.
NEOW.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.1-: Is this a regression? I can feel it again, the corruption atop the Spire...
DARV.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.0-: Pick anything you like! As long as you understand their value!
DARV.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.1-: Pick anything you like! As long as you understand their value!
These things... I do not need them.
Single-mindedly pursuing correctness? Then go find the Architect. My collection will always be here waiting for you—!
You! You! Climbed so high!! Shiny justice!! Here! Get stronger!
You! You! Climbed so high!! Shiny justice!! Here! Get stronger!
Power should not be given so easily... What is your intention?
Lonely... Want to see light! Want to see victory! Want villains to shatter!! Take it! Go fight! I will watch from here!
...I understand. I will use it to uphold justice. Not for you.
PAEL.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.0-: Take it... a part of me... may it bring you peace...
PAEL.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.1-: Take it... a part of me... may it bring you peace...
Your power... it comes from sacrificing yourself?
The Spire... is too noisy... You go fight... quiet the Architect's twisted correctness...
I accept this power. I will go correct the Architect, just as I once corrected my past self.
TEZCATARA.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HI: Traveler of justice... power demands a price.
Traveler of justice... power demands a price.
I am willing to bear the price, for my ideal of innocence.
Very well, may the flame be with you... Do not let it... consume you...
I shall master it. With this burning justice, I will illuminate the top of the Spire.
NONUPEIPE.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HI: Traveler, do you desire beauty and fortune? Take my gift, let the Spire shine for you.
Traveler, do you desire beauty and fortune? Take my gift, let the Spire shine for you.
I will trade strength for peace, to end this chaos.
Very well, may your journey bloom with flowers, and every card become a treasure. Go, for the beauty within your soul.
TANX.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.0-: Weakling! Come fight me! If you win, I'll grant you power!
TANX.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.1-: Weakling! Come fight me! If you win, I'll grant you power!
This is incorrect. My enemy is the corruption atop the Spire.
Haha! Interesting! A strong weakling — use my power to correct everything!
VAKUU.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.0: Such strong conviction! Go and kill that wretched Architect!!
VAKUU.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.1: Such strong conviction! Go and kill that wretched Architect!!
Incorrect! Evil! Once I correct the corruption atop the Spire, I will return to incinerate you, demon!
Fine fine fine! Such delusion! Let us see how far your laughable justice can carry you!
[i][b](Hiro furrows his brow and grips his blade) Disgusting.[/b][/i]
MANOSABA_LIN_EVENT_WITCHOFTHE_ISLAND.pag: While exploring, you encounter an ancient being known as the Witch of the Island.
MANOSABA_LIN_EVENT_WITCHOFTHE_ISLAND.tal: [i](Though faint, there is indeed a voice)[/i]
I only hope that [color=#cccccc][She][/color]... can find [b][Happiness][/b] in coexistence with humans.
Please tell [color=#cccccc][Her][/color]... that [color=#cccccc][She][/color] no longer needs to bear [jitter][b][the fate of being born a witch][/b][/jitter].
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTE: Ah... there is a very peculiar aura about you. Not a creation of the Spire, nor an ordinary mortal. That power... it is cursed.
Once you set foot here, there is no turning back.
Once you set foot here, there is no turning back.
Even if the road ahead is hard, I will not shrink back.
New little one! Come see my collection?!
New little one! Come see my collection?!
Just passing by. I don't have anything to trade.
No worries, take a look! Come back anytime!
OROBAS.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_EMALI: Found it found it!! This one isn't pretty... This one sparkles!! But wrong!! What Orobas is looking for is—
Found it found it!! This one isn't pretty... This one sparkles!! But wrong!! What Orobas is looking for is—
Um, hello. I'm just passing by. Is this... your home?
Here here— take these!! Take the sparkles!! It'll make your heart feel a little warmer!!
There are many who are stronger than me. Those who can truly help... thank you.
...A new guest has arrived. Don't worry, the melted parts won't burn you. Have a seat.
...A new guest has arrived. Don't worry, the melted parts won't burn you. Have a seat.
...Don't you find me strange? Coming into the Spire alone, knowing nothing, always being a burden to others.
I have been melting. Every day. Every moment. Others think I am fading away— but in truth, I am regenerating. The old flows away, the new grows back. It hurts, but it is not a bad thing.
...I will come again. Not for a part of you.
Learn from me. Find some peace.
TEZCATARA.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_EM: You humans are all the same. Enter with flaws, leave with resolve— then return with new flaws. Welcome back.
You humans are all the same. Enter with flaws, leave with resolve— then return with new flaws. Welcome back.
Forgive yourself first. Those who burn away their flaws have the right to start anew.
Thank you. A little lighter now, but my steps are steadier than before.
NONUPEIPE.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_EM: Oh my, your attire looks rather dull. Come, let me pick some beautiful things for you to wear.
Oh my, your attire looks rather dull. Come, let me pick some beautiful things for you to wear.
...Dull? This is already my most formal attire.
A noble visitor deserves a noble blessing. Little girl, strength does not lie in what you have done, but in what you wish to do. Wear my power and destroy the madness atop the Spire.
So weak! You don't even have the strength to grip a weapon?!
So weak! You don't even have the strength to grip a weapon?!
...Um, hello. My name is Ema Sakurahane. I'm... not very good with weapons.
You don't swing a blade, yet you already judge others! The mouth is a powerful weapon!! The dark red one refused to fight me too, and so do you! But you're both interesting!
VAKUU.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_EMALIN: Ah— Ema Sakurahane. You've come at last. I've been waiting for you for so long. Give yourself to me, and you can become as feared as I am!
Ah— Ema Sakurahane. You've come at last. I've been waiting for you for so long. Give yourself to me, and you can become as feared as I am!
I won't sign. Forgiveness isn't something you buy. Someone like you would never understand— because you don't think anything needs to be forgiven.
Too weak. A little girl who can't even grip a weapon dares to threaten a demon?!
You're not helping them. You're turning them into puppets. Into more people just like you. I don't need that kind of help.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTE: Wow, the top of the Spire! Is this the truth behind everything?!
Pure power, pure emotion. A useless doll.
Go back and find your stuffing, then come again.
NEOW.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_SHERRYL: Another awakened soul... I sense an unusual aura about you. You seem... not afraid at all?
Another awakened soul... I sense an unusual aura about you. You seem... not afraid at all?
My name is Tachibana Sherry, and I'm a detective!
A detective... Have you come seeking the truth? The secrets hidden within this Spire are enough to drive most people mad.
DARV.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_SHERRYL: [Darv is buried in a pile of metal fragments, muttering to himself]
[Darv is buried in a pile of metal fragments, muttering to himself]

Wow, so many mysterious collectibles! This is really interesting~
Do you hoard so many things — maybe hiding a key piece of evidence? Like something that could unlock the truth of the Spire, some chamber of secrets?

[jitter][Darv laughs heartily][/jitter]
I just simply enjoy sharing my collection! If you find any curiosities while climbing the Spire, come back and trade new pieces with me!
OROBAS.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_SHERR: Visitor!! Stories and riddles! Detective stories!
Visitor!! Stories and riddles! Detective stories!
My story? My story isn't that interesting. But I know many stories about others— detective novels and real cases alike~

[Sherry keeps sharing the stories she knows]
Interesting! Interesting!

That's the end of the stories I know.
Hmm~ Your very existence is the greatest unsolved mystery of the Spire, isn't it? Are you also searching for your own truth?
Then go! Unravel every mystery this Spire holds!
PAEL.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_SHERRYL: Tired... then stop and rest a while. The Spire's path is too hard, its wind and snow too cold.
Tired... then stop and rest a while. The Spire's path is too hard, its wind and snow too cold.
I'm detective Tachibana Sherry. Forgive me for disturbing your rest. Does it hurt, giving pieces of your own flesh to strangers again and again? Do you ever get tired?
Your eyes are very clear, very pure. My body can regenerate endlessly— there is no need for pity, no need for heartache.
A detective's duty is to see every truth that has been overlooked~
Thank you... May the road ahead never force you to be strong, and may you always be treated with gentleness...
TEZCATARA.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_SH: Come closer to the fire. Let my flame warm you and heal you.
Come closer to the fire. Let my flame warm you and heal you.
I'm detective Tachibana Sherry. Thank you for sharing your warmth with a stranger climber.
The long climb up the Spire is harsh and cold, slaughter and darkness never cease. I was born of flame— I exist to spread light.
NONUPEIPE.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_SH: Little one who has come from afar, welcome to my magnificent domain.
Little one who has come from afar, welcome to my magnificent domain.
Hello! Your hall is truly gorgeous, and you yourself are elegant and noble— the most refined and gentle being I've met in the Spire.

Hehe, you have good taste. Your appearance is very endearing, though your attire is rather plain and monotonous. No matter— since you are here, I shall bestow upon you fortune and a blessing of beauty.
TANX.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_SHERRYL: Another climber setting foot in the arena! The Spire's carnage never ceases— perfect, you can keep me company and loosen up my muscles!
Another climber setting foot in the arena! The Spire's carnage never ceases— perfect, you can keep me company and loosen up my muscles!
Hmm~ I'm actually pretty strong~ Let's try without weapons!

[b][Sent flying by Sherry][/b]
[jitter]Ugh, a little detective with enormous strength! Interesting! Finally, someone who understands me![/jitter]
These relics don't need to be traded for— they are purely a gift. Even if you don't love battle, may you have the courage to face any danger!
VAKUU.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_SHERRY: Oh? Another little one setting foot in the hall of contracts. So you too crave instant power and are willing to pay any price for a profitable deal with me?
Oh? Another little one setting foot in the hall of contracts. So you too crave instant power and are willing to pay any price for a profitable deal with me?
That sounds like an incredibly tempting deal. But I also know that you enjoy watching mortals trapped by their desires, unable to move forward or backward.

The little one has sharp eyes! All living beings have obsessions— greed, revenge, the ambition to reach the summit— they are all my best bargaining chips. I need only toss out a little bait, and they willingly offer up their own bottom line. This game never gets old.

Pure evil. A being with only one emotion is not worth learning from.
[Sherry ignores the still-talking Vakuu and leaves without looking back.]
